title: About
description: Learn how this headless site template combines TinaCMS with fast static delivery.

hero.title: Edit content without editing code
hero.lede: A static site can still give content editors a focused, visual publishing workflow.

cards.title: Visual editing
cards.body: Tina maps editable content directly to the rendered page.

cards.title: Static delivery
cards.body: Every approved change is committed to Git and deployed as static output.

sections.title: Ready to customize it?
sections.body: Create your own pages from the Tina admin, then replace this example with your real content.
